summary: Full backend + frontend test of the new 'Lediga tjänster' (careers) feature plus regressions. Backend: 25 pytest tests (auth, admin protection, public jobs, admin jobs CRUD incl. unpublish-hides-from-public, news, contact) - all 25 passed. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): public /lediga-tjanster list + job detail + mailto buttons, kontakt careers-link internal navigation, footer link, admin login + news/jobs tabs + full job create/edit/delete cycle with public visibility check, /nyheter regression, homepage marquee removal, contact form UI submit (POST /api/contact -> 200 {status:success,email_sent:true}). All flows passed. Test data cleaned up: only seeded 'Servicetekniker' job remains, TEST_ contact messages deleted.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / lockout - unlimited failed login attempts allowed (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails). Verified 401 on wrong password but no rate limiting/lockout state.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid combination per the Fetch spec; browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests with wildcard. Works today only because auth uses a Bearer header, not cookies. Recommend explicit origins.

JWT is returned in the JSON body and stored in localStorage (vent_admin_token) - no httpOnly cookie. Deviates from the auth playbook (httpOnly cookie) and is XSS-exposed. Informational: consistent with existing news admin pattern.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid is generated as 'footer-link-lediga tjänster' (contains a space and non-ASCII 'ä'); the slug helper only replaces 'å'. Works but is a brittle/inconsistent testid. Suggest explicit slugs.

issues: 'Lediga tjänster' is only reachable from the footer and the /kontakt careers block - it is not in the top navigation (0 header links found). Consider adding it to the primary nav for discoverability.

action_items: Optional: add explicit CORS origins instead of "*" while allow_credentials=True
Optional: add login attempt lockout/rate limiting on POST /api/auth/login
Optional: add 'Lediga tjänster' to top navigation and use ASCII-safe footer data-testids
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~350 lines and fine now, but news and jobs CRUD are near-identical duplicated blocks (serialize_post/serialize_job, 4 endpoints each) - consider a generic collection router to keep it DRY as more content types are added.

PUT /api/admin/jobs/{id} does a full $set of the model, so any field omitted by a client silently resets to its default (e.g. location -> 'Stockholm', published -> true). Admin UI always sends all fields so it is safe today; consider a partial-update model.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from all serialized responses (verified in tests).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Ventilationsmontör (API) and TEST_UI Projektledare (UI) jobs; 2 TEST_ contact messages submitted (1 API, 1 UI) and both deleted from db. Only seeded 'Servicetekniker' job remains; 5 news posts untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env, cleans up its own jobs). Contact form actually sends email via Resend (email_sent=true) - limit to one submission per run. Jobs collection must keep only 'Servicetekniker'. Note: page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') times out on this app (WDS websocket) - wait for selectors instead.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Only hardening/consistency observations listed above.
